data: NVIDIA's fiscal 2024, which ended January 28, 2024, produced record revenue of $60.9 billion, up 126% from $27.0 billion in fiscal 2023 (the year ended January 29, 2023). Net income was $29.8 billion, a sharp rise of about 581% from $4.4 billion the prior year, driven largely by demand for data center GPUs used in AI workloads. Data center revenue alone reached roughly $47.5 billion, up 217% year over year.
